failure_modes: No change in endpoint contrast at the selected landmark relative to the incumbent (the declared discriminating failure for any permitted edit).
Sign reversal in batch direction of the targeted endpoint contrast.
A coordinate change that claims discrimination below the information-audit bound (compressed-choice excess fixed RMS 0.081 A) without independent validation.
A temporal edit whose contrast trajectory requires extrapolation outside the observed support [0.0,0.49].
A shape_yy/local_cyy change accompanied by global-centroid motion, indicating a pose rather than shape effect.

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence does not establish a defensible expected advantage for any single registered edit, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so the strongest endpoint contrasts (pair_kernel_1.5-5.0, endpoint_effects:9-12) cannot be expressed by the permitted reward recipe. The most multiplicity-robust directions (joint_innovation_RMS_A, joint_internal_RMS_A; branch_adjusted:74,76,151,153,228,230,305,307) are likewise diagnostic-only and are not terms of the executing scalar. The global-centroid direction is split at or below chance (branch_adjusted:0,1,2,77,78,79), so it is not a defensible target. The time-conditioned alternative is not supported: the continuous contrasts span only [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation allowed and dense sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:1,3,7), so a temporal_region_index/temporal_teacher_blend edit would rest on a poorly fitted, frequently sign-flipping contrast rather than a validated salience. The turnover and increment evidence (turnover:1,2,14,17,47,134,224,227,254,257,497,524,584,587; increment_effects:3,4,7,10,13,14,15) is consistent with cohort-composition and parent-weighting accounting rather than a within-path coordinate change, so it does not justify an edit. The information audit bounds achievable coordinate discrimination (compressed-choice excess fixed RMS 0.081 A; top4 teacher overlap 0.47; chosen teacher score correlation 0.10) and states it is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, so no permitted edit can be shown to move the primary affinity objective. Decoded terminal labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support terminal_metadata at score time 0.99/state time 1.0), so descendant credit cannot be read as final affinity benefit. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because no registered bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the discriminating failure condition for any future edit would be no change in the endpoint contrast at the selected landmark relative to the incumbent.
